label: sec:crossing-energy-intro
html: Localizing the global Möbius self-avoidance kernel at the crossings of a braid projection decomposes the crossing energy E_\times (Definition) into a symmetric strong baseline and an orientation-odd electromagnetic shift proportional to the Coulomb charge Q(\mathfrak{H}) = \tfrac{1}{2}(n_+ - n_-) (Definition). This section develops these crossing-energy identities on the trefoil and in the commutative limit over the categorical coordinate ring R[i, q^{\pm 1}].
